correctness.rationale: For any edge correlations obeying the triangle determinant bound, a recursive tree embedding into fresh orthogonal directions yields a joint unit-vector Gram realization. Hence conditional y-edge fibers are independent intervals. Fubini and the 2^{-(2n-1)} Jacobian prove the beta-product formula. Strict Hölder yields strict convexity of log J_d; tree degree sequences are majorized between path and star, giving rigid extrema; the gamma ratio gives the stated constant and base. The exact standard-library verifier passed 280392 Prüfer-encoded labeled tree comparisons and 480 constructive Gram checks plus quadrature/identity checks. Finite checks do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Projected elliptope volume is a quantitative measure of PSD relaxation size for cut geometry, studied directly in the 2017 and 2026 volume literature. This solves the natural complete tree-suspension family exactly, gives non-obvious invariance under tree reshuffling at fixed degrees, and identifies unique path/star extremizers with an exact exponentially divergent ratio. It is not a narrow arbitrary parameter slice: all trees of every order are covered. The already-known star case is not counted as new value by itself.
